original_outcome: due rewards are not optional generated media
scope: Design basis using actual EncounterDirector; source-addressed consequence references are not executable effects or rewards
decision: Admitted required consequences remain ordered, source-bound staged proposals when optional media is absent. Missing or refused required source authority returns a typed refusal; absence of optional media grants no source authority.

source_decisions.basis: Source-legal encounter proposals are pure; session commits gameplay state. Standard progression/rewards are due despite provider/media failure.
Required source references are admitted and cloned in caller order, with exact current basis/pins and bounded work. No checkpoint mutation or award execution.

bounded_example.expected: Both admitted source-addressed consequence references remain ordered; checkpoint resources and all other state remain unchanged.

alternatives.choice: Gate required consequence references on optional generated media
alternatives.disposition: Rejected: optional presentation must not erase the source-legal basis of due consequences.

alternatives.choice: Treat missing required sources as successful partial resolution
alternatives.disposition: Rejected: Denied, Unavailable and Unsupported are typed SourceGap refusals.

alternatives.choice: Invent RewardGrant or mutate resources from EncounterDirector
alternatives.disposition: Rejected: shared reward shape/source behavior and durable session composition need their owning reviewed contracts.

unresolved: Actual shared RewardGrant shape/source-qualified due rewards
Production resolution and durable due-award execution in rules/session
Provider/media runtime, independent review and Main integration are unperformed by this source example
